The generated model has only bare end events named after the outcomes (X15, X16), so both tasks are missing (M1, M2). The description states the cycle repeats until the student graduates or withdraws (S20), and these are actions performed by the student. The learned guideli)

refines FLOW-07 (The description states that the process repeats each semester until the student graduates or withdraws (S20). The generated model lacks the task for each final outcome (M1, M2) and the exclusive gateway that closes the repetition loop (M3). FLOW-07 says loops are represented only when repetition is stated and need a meaningful exit, but it does not say how the named exit outcomes should be modeled)

same as LRN-047 (The description states that the process repeats each semester until the student graduates or withdraws. The generated model has no 'Graduate' or 'Withdraw' task and no exclusive gateway at the end of the cycle, so both named outcomes and the loop-back branch are missing. The missing gateway (M3) and the two outcome tasks (M1, M2) show that the cycle exit was not modeled as one task per named outco)

same as LRN-011 (The reference splits and joins the study-plan parts with parallel gateways (M7, M8), while the generated model left them without the join, so the difference is a structural gateway omission. The description lists the study-plan parts as items of one plan with no order, including 'Resolving any schedule conflicts' (S13). LRN-011 and LRN-010 already require parallel split and join for unordered list)

same as LRN-047 (The description repeats each semester until the student graduates or withdraws. The generated model ends directly in two end events named after the outcomes (X15, X16), while the reference has a task for each outcome before the merge (M1, M2) and a decision gateway after the semester outcome step (M3). LRN-047 already states that a repeated sequence should exit through one task per named final out)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists two or more actions that must all be carried out after a common point, with no order or alternative stated between them, and only then leads to a later step: Model a parallel gateway that splits into one task per listed action, keeping each action as its own task with the description's wording, in a separate branch. Join all branches with a parallel gateway before the later step, so the later step waits for every action. Do not chain the actions in sequence, do not use an exclusive gateway for them, and do not leave any branch without a connecting flow to the join.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states two or more actions that are performed by the same participant after a common point, either as items of one listed sub-activity or as concurrent work, and a later step follows only once all of them are complete

rules_sent_back.instruction: When The description says a repeated cycle is left only when an actor performs an action that terminates the process, and that action is work the actor carries out rather than a message, signal, or time occurrence.: Model each such exit action as its own bpmn:task in the actor's lane or pool, placed on the branch that leaves the repeated cycle, before its end event. Use a gateway to route from the cycle to these exit branches. Do not replace an exit action with a bare end event named after its outcome. Keep the cycle's back-edge for the non-exit path.
rules_sent_back.situation: The description says a repeated cycle is left only when an actor performs an action that terminates the process, and that action is work the actor carries out rather than a message, signal, or time occurrence.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a repeated sequence of activities runs each period until the participant reaches one of several named final outcomes: Model an exclusive gateway that returns to the first repeated activity and exits through one task per named final outcome. Each outcome task leads to an end event, so no named outcome is left out of the model.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a repeated sequence of activities runs each period until the participant reaches one of several named final outcomes

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists two or more activities that are performed without a stated order and must all be completed before a later step begins: Model a parallel gateway that splits into one outgoing branch per listed activity, and a parallel gateway that joins those branches before the next step. Do not chain the activities in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway for them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description introduces a list of items as parts of one plan or activity (for example, a sentence ending in 'which includes:' followed by several items) with no stated order among them, and the plan only moves on once all items are done
